_comment: flywheel factory event log. OPT-IN: pg-log.sh exits immediately unless ~/.local/state/pg-factory/ exists, so installing this plugin changes nothing until you run `mkdir -p ~/.local/state/pg-factory`. Only the six events both Claude Code and Droid document are registered, so one file serves both harnesses. Two details are load-bearing and were verified live on both harnesses 2026-09-01, not read off the docs: (1) the plugin-root reference MUST be double-quoted -- Claude Code passes the command to a shell and relies on it to expand $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, so single quotes make it a literal and every hook dies with 'cannot open ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/...' , while Droid substitutes textually and works either way; and (2) PostToolUse carries NO matcher -- Claude Code reads the matcher as a regex and matches every tool when it is omitted (a `matcher: "*"` entry logged nothing at all), Droid matches all tools with it omitted too, and registering both forms made Droid fire twice for a single tool call. async:true is honoured by Claude Code and ignored by Droid, which runs the hook synchronously at ~9ms.
